activity_summary: At the yard you kept the new page at home. Kemp asked what was in the sleeve, and you showed him an empty one and the comedy. Burbage told you to keep the other look upstairs. Heminges counted four days and a dark door. Garnish checked the one paste. Phillips did not spend the cuckoo. Nobody was shown the morning's sheet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Showed an empty sleeve and left the new page upstairs.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked for the sleeve, accepted that he had not been shown a sheet, and stayed in his old place.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted four days and ended the accounting.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept Berowne, believed the empty sleeve, and sent the other look home.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Checked the slip and kept ink off the plot.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Held the cuckoo for Monday and taught no new note.

facets.activity: Rehearsed the comedy and kept the page upstairs

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Thou art somewhere else behind the eyes.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Easter Monday is four days off.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The page is upstairs, and it is not coming down to be shown.
